name: Flocks SOC Case Management
description: Persistent SOC investigation, immutable evidence, human-approved device response and verified incident retrospectives through the Flocks tool lifecycle.
descriptionCn: SOC 事件调查、证据、人工审批处置与效果核验、复盘改进；设备操作遵循 Flocks 原工具执行与策略链。

reasons: Approved response plans can invoke registered security device tools, including network operations, through their normal credential, policy and audit gates. This plugin has no independent network transport.
